methodologyNotes: Roster of 10 independently re-verified compact/mini refrigerators (under ~5 cu ft) for dorm, office, and personal use. Each product was cross-checked against the manufacturer page, the U.S. EPA ENERGY STAR certified-residential-refrigerators database (by EPA detail ID), and at least one major or specialist retailer. Adversarial corrections applied: (1) Midea WHS-65LB1 separate_freezer changed true->false — manufacturer specs describe a chiller compartment (28.4-35.6F, above freezing), not a true freezer; (2) BLACK+DECKER BCRK17V price corrected 114.19->156.83 to current Home Depot retail; (3) Magic Chef MCAR320B2 energy_star changed true->null — the exact SKU is absent from the ENERGY STAR database (only MCAR320PSE / HMCR320BE siblings are certified) and its dead Office Depot corroboration URL was replaced with a live Newegg page. No products were removed; all 10 exist and were corroborated. priceUsd reflects MSRP or typical current US retail observed during research; null where no published USD price could be confirmed. Booleans: true = feature present. accessedAt 2026-06-20.

products.name: Midea WHS-65LB1 Compact Refrigerator
products.provenance: 1.6 cu ft single-door, ENERGY STAR certified (EPA ID 2349060, cert 2024-07-12, market 2024-07-03, 207 kWh/yr), reversible door, mechanical thermostat. CORRECTION: separate_freezer set to false — Midea US spec lists a chiller compartment cooling to 28.4-35.6F (-2 to 2C, above freezing) with total capacity equal to refrigerator capacity; it is not a true separate freezer. No can dispenser. Price ~$119.99 per Amazon (B00MVVI1FC).

products.name: Frigidaire EFR341 3.2 Cu Ft 2-Door Compact Fridge with Freezer
products.provenance: 3.2 cu ft double-door top-freezer, ENERGY STAR certified (EPA ID 2382098 = EFR341, 312 kWh/yr, cert 2021-06-01, market 2021-06-07). Reversible door, can dispenser, 2L door basket, adjustable thermostat confirmed by retailer spec sheets. NOTE: the Amazon URL (B088GVQX34) now serves the successor SKU EFR3A1 — same 3.2 cu ft Platinum-series product. Price ~$219.68 (retailer range $185-270).

products.name: BLACK+DECKER BCRK17V 1.7 Cu Ft Mini Fridge with Freezer
products.priceNote: Current Home Depot retail (Stainless Look); varies by retailer
products.provenance: 1.7 cu ft single-door. Manufacturer confirms full-width freezer compartment with ice tray (true freezer), reversible door, adjustable thermostat, ENERGY STAR (EPA ID 2269098 = BCRK17B sibling SKU of same certified family, 201 kWh/yr, cert 2016-06-02). No can dispenser. CORRECTION: priceUsd 114.19 -> 156.83 per current Home Depot listing; the old figure was stale.

products.name: Danby Diplomat DCR044B1SLM 4.4 Cu Ft Compact Fridge
products.provenance: 4.4 cu ft single-door with full-width chiller section (not a true freezer; separate_freezer=false). ENERGY STAR certified (EPA ID 2338888, 228 kWh/yr, cert 2019-05-14, market 2019-05-17), reversible door, mechanical thermostat. Verified real across danby.com, Abt (~$289.99), Walmart, Home Depot CA. Substituted for the unverifiable original DCR044B1BSLDB SKU. No can dispenser.

products.name: Cooluli Classic 4L Thermoelectric Mini Fridge
products.provenance: 4L (0.14 cu ft) thermoelectric 2-in-1 cooler/warmer (cools 35-40F below ambient, warms to 149F), AC/DC/USB. No compressor, no ENERGY STAR, no reversible door, no freezer. cooluli.com confirms $47.95 sale / $69.99 MSRP; Lowes lists same 0.14 cu ft model (CL4LBK). Release year not publicly disclosed (null).

products.name: Galanz GLR46TBKER Retro 4.6 Cu Ft Mini Fridge with Dual Door
products.priceNote: Best Buy retail; historical Amazon deal ~$223
products.provenance: 4.6 cu ft retro dual-door with true top-mount freezer (<=0F). ENERGY STAR certified (EPA ID 2311061 exact match, 325 kWh/yr, cert 2018-02-08, market 2018-04-01), mechanical thermostat, reversible doors. Fresh-food 3.25 cu ft + freezer 1.31 cu ft confirmed. No can dispenser. Price $199.99 per Best Buy.

products.name: Insignia NS-CF26BK9 2.6 Cu Ft Mini Fridge
products.priceNote: Original Best Buy MSRP; discontinued/clearance, street price now ~$90-120
products.provenance: 2.6 cu ft single-door, ENERGY STAR certified (confirmed on Best Buy/Insignia listings), reversible door, door-mounted can rack + bottle storage, mechanical thermostat (32-39.2F), no separate freezer. $149.99 original Best Buy MSRP confirmed (now discontinued from new stock, clearance/secondary street price ~$90-120). Source upgraded from secondary reseller to official Best Buy page. Release year not publicly disclosed (null).

products.name: Magic Chef MCAR320B2 3.2 Cu Ft All-Refrigerator
products.provenance: 3.2 cu ft all-refrigerator (no separate freezer; 'all-refrigerator' confirmed by Newegg/manufacturer), reversible door, 12-oz can dispenser, adjustable thermostat, auto-defrost, 259 kWh/yr. CORRECTION: energy_star true -> null — the exact SKU MCAR320B2 is absent from the EPA ENERGY STAR database (certified siblings are MCAR320PSE [id 2326085] and HMCR320BE [id 2321139]); no source confirms certification for this SKU. Corroboration URL changed from dead/geo-blocked Office Depot listing to live Newegg page. Price ~$189.99 specialty-dealer list (Amazon history ~$121-150). Release year not found (null).

products.name: RCA RFR321 3.2 Cu Ft Mini Fridge with Freezer
products.provenance: 3.2 cu ft single-door with freezer compartment. ENERGY STAR certified (EPA ID 2372963 = RFR321-B-WHITE, 197 kWh/yr, cert 2021-01-20, market 2021-01-04), reversible door, door-side can dispenser + 2L bottle holder, adjustable thermostat. Price $159.99 (from $179.99) confirmed on woodartsupply.com.

Sold as 'Fizz 95' on euhomy.com (verifiable; the requested 'BC-95' SKU was unconfirmable). energy_star=null — not stated on product page and not found in EPA database.
